mentions.name: glasscn
mentions.description: A shadcn registry of React components inspired by Apple's glassmorphism design that ports native Apple UI components and paradigms to the web. It also ships native components integrating with React Native / Expo, enabling apps with a consistent look and feel across all platforms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been creating an Apple / "glassmorphism" inspired shadcn registry of React components. The idea is to port the native Apple ui components and paradigms to the web. This library also goes beyond the web and ships native components that integrate with React Native / Expo, so you can build an app with 99% the same look and feel across all platforms.
